# MeedyaDL 1.10.0-alpha.15

A large pre-release focused on **portability** (your settings, queue, history, and library index now travel between machines via a single `.meedyabundle` file), **a new Lyricsfile YAML format** for word-level synced lyrics that LRCGET can read, a **fresh SQLite-backed download index** that makes "do I already have this?" checks instant, and a **memory-leak EPIC** that prevents long-running sessions from creeping up to multi-gigabyte RAM. Plus GAMDL 3.7.3 support, queue Pause/Resume, and a swath of housekeeping.

### What's new

- **Profile Bundle (`.meedyabundle`) — your whole MeedyaDL state in one file.** Settings → General now has an Export and Import button. Bundles travel settings, the queue, download history, the new SQLite library index, the activity log, and download manifests between machines (or to back yourself up before reinstalling). Sensitive material — Apple Music cookies, MusicKit private keys, the web-player developer token — is encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (600 000 iterations); credentials need a password to import. On first launch the setup wizard scans Downloads / Desktop / home for `.meedyabundle` files and offers to restore from one so a re-install picks up where you left off. (#876)
- **Lyricsfile (`.lyrics`) YAML sidecars.** Settings → Lyrics → "Generate Lyricsfile (.lyrics)" emits the new open lyrics format jointly endorsed by [LRCGET 2.0](https://github.com/tranxuanthang/lrcget/releases/tag/2.0.0) and [LRCLIB](https://lrclib.net/). It preserves Apple Music's word-level timing in a plain-text-editable YAML document that any text editor (and LRCGET itself) can read, and existing `.lyrics` files are never overwritten on re-download — so edits you make in LRCGET survive. Off by default; the format is officially experimental per upstream's own release notes. (#596)
- **SQLite download index.** A new SQLite database mirrors download history, the activity log, and library state alongside the existing JSON files. Smart-redownload detection, duplicate detection, and library-gap scans now read from SQLite first (with JSON as fallback for older installs), which makes "is this album already downloaded?" feel instant on big libraries. On first launch after upgrading, MeedyaDL silently ingests your existing `history.json` and `activity-YYYY-MM-DD.log` files into the database. (#875)
- **Pause and Resume the queue without losing anything.** A new green Pause/Resume button sits alongside the destructive red Abort button on the Download and Queue pages. Pause leaves every queued and in-flight item exactly where it is; Resume picks them back up. Use this when you need the download bandwidth back for a video call or want to chain a few more URLs before kicking the queue off. (#889)
- **Library scan now detects codec-tier gaps from your manifest's plan.** When you scanned a folder previously, the "Re-download" button only fired if entire tracks were missing. Now it also detects when only certain codec variants are missing (e.g., you previously downloaded Atmos → ALAC but the ALAC files are gone) and re-fetches just those. (#766)
- **Library scan: retroactive `Cover.<ext>` cleanup.** Folders downloaded before the Cover.jpg dedup fix (below) often have *two* cover art files — the GAMDL-default `Cover.jpg` and whatever stem you've configured (e.g., `FrontCover.jpg`). Library Scan now spots and offers to remove the duplicate during a folder scan, so you don't have to clean them up by hand. (#892 follow-up)
- **Wrapper LAN deployment guidance.** Settings → Advanced → Wrapper now shows a security hint when your wrapper URL points at anything other than `127.0.0.1` or `localhost`, and a new docs page covers running the wrapper on a separate machine on your LAN (e.g., a Raspberry Pi or Docker host) — including which ports to forward and why you shouldn't expose them to the open internet. (#891, [Docker wrapper GAMDL guide v2](docs/docker-wrapper-gamdl-guide-v2.md))
- **GAMDL 3.7.3 admitted to the support window.** Picks up upstream's defensive fix for unstreamable items — songs and music-videos missing `playParams` no longer crash with a `KeyError`. Audio songs are unaffected. (#898)
- **Library URLs (`/library/albums/l.XXXX`) no longer log noisy 404s.** When you queue a personal-library URL, MeedyaDL now correctly skips the Apple Music catalog enrichment step that doesn't apply, so the activity log stays clean. (#871)

### What's fixed

- **Long sessions could grow MeedyaDL's RAM to multiple gigabytes — fixed across four code paths.** A few buffers in the download pipeline, toast queue, activity-log writer, and per-download counter map weren't bounded; once you'd queued a long playlist or kept the app open for a few hours, RAM would climb without ever settling back. All four are now bounded: subprocess output uses a ring buffer (#893), toasts share a single dismissal timer instead of one per toast (#894), per-download counters are evicted at terminal states (#895), and the on-disk activity-log writer drops events above a 10 000-event burst with a counter to surface the drop (#896). Long-running queues should now hold steady around their baseline RSS. (#897)
- **"Retry without Wrapper" pill is now actually visible** when a download fails because your wrapper is unreachable. Previously the pill blended into the activity log row and most users never saw it. Now it sits as a distinct amber action button next to the failed item. (#890)
- **`/song/{slug}/{id}` Apple Music URLs are now accepted** even without the album-context query parameter — the URL parser used to require `?i=...` on every song link. (#888)
- **Duplicate `Cover.<ext>` files are removed during the cover-art rename step.** When the user-configured cover art stem (e.g., `FrontCover`) already existed in the album directory, GAMDL's default `Cover.jpg` would silently stick around as a duplicate. The rename step now deletes the unused source instead. (#892)
- **Apple Music's "Media is not streamable" error now gets actionable guidance** instead of the generic "Check the Activity Log for more details." When content is region-locked, removed, or only present in your personal library, the activity log explains what's wrong and what to try (different storefront, catalog URL). The error string itself has existed in GAMDL for several releases; what's new in 3.7.2 / 3.7.3 is that it actually reaches you instead of being masked by a `KeyError` traceback. (#898)
- **AcoustID, ReplayGain, and Chromaprint fingerprinting** now flow through the new shared `meedya-fingerprint` crate from MeedyaSuite-core instead of three independent local implementations. Functionally identical for users — same fingerprints, same tags, same wire format — but the codebase is ~200 lines smaller and the same upstream library will eventually power the rest of the MeedyaSuite app family. ARM Linux property preserved: still pure-Rust audio decode, no `fpcalc` binary required. (#353)
- **Toggle switches in Settings** now announce their description text to screen readers reliably across VoiceOver, NVDA, and Orca. Previously some screen readers (notably Orca on Linux) only read the toggle label without the helper text underneath. (#125)
- **German and French translations** were missing the entire `Download`, `Queue`, `Activity`, and `History` sections (~50 keys per locale). When a user picked German or French these pages silently fell back to English. Both locales are now at parity with English, and a new parity test prevents this from drifting again. (#111)

### Performance

- The first time you open MeedyaDL after upgrading, it builds the new SQLite download index from your existing history. Subsequent launches read from the database directly — duplicate-detection and library-gap queries that used to scan thousands of JSON lines now hit an indexed lookup. Most noticeable on libraries with >1000 downloads in history. (#875)
- The four memory-leak fixes above (#893–#896) reduce peak RAM for typical long-running queues by an order of magnitude. Pre-fix, a 50-toast burst scheduled 50 individual timers and held onto per-toast closure state until each fired; post-fix, every toast shares a single 250 ms worker loop and the timer count stays bounded regardless of toast volume. (#897)

### Notes

- This is a pre-release on the **alpha** channel; the Lyricsfile (`.lyrics`) format is itself experimental per [LRCGET's own release notes](https://github.com/tranxuanthang/lrcget/releases/tag/2.0.0) and the YAML schema may change in future versions. Enable the toggle if you want to try it; leave it off for stable workflows.
- Profile Bundle export/import is new and exhaustive — if you rely on a specific quirk of your current settings file format, please export once, inspect the bundle's contents, and confirm everything you expected is in there before relying on it for backup.
- Cross-suite portability: `.meedyabundle` files are designed to be read by future MeedyaSuite apps (MeedyaConverter, MeedyaManager) too. For now MeedyaDL is the only producer/consumer; when imports come from another producer the wizard surfaces a warning.
- GAMDL 3.7.2 changed music-video tag emission to use *uncensored* track / album names where available. Songs are unaffected. If you have a music-video filename template using `{title}` or `{album}`, the resulting files post-upgrade may have slightly different names than before; re-downloading the same MV after the upgrade will create a new file rather than skipping. (Audit details: `.github/audits/gamdl-v3.7.2-v3.7.3-audit.md`.)
